definitions.short: Malcam or Milcom , the national idol of the Ammonites
definitions.full: H4445. Malkam מַלְכָּם proper name, masculine a Benjamite 1Chr 8:9 . ᵐ5 B Μελχας , A Μελχαμ , ᵐ5 L Μελχομ . On Jer 49:1 , 3 ; Zeph 1:5 see מִלְכֹּם . מִלְכֹּם proper name, of a divinity Milcom, god of Ammonites (compare RS Semitic i. 67 ) — ׳מ עַמֹּנִים שִׁקֻּץ 1Kin 11:5 (|| עַשְׁתֹּרֶת ); compare ׳מ עַמּוֺן בְנֵי אֱלֹהֵי 11:33 (|| ׳ע + כְּמוֺשׁ ), so read also (for מֹלֶךְ ᵑ0 ) 11:7 (|| כְּמוֺשׁ ); בְּנֵיעַֿמּוֺן ׳מ תּוֺעֲבַת 2Kin 23:13 (|| as 1Kin 11:33 ); read מִלְכֹּם also for מַלְכָּם Jer 49:1 , 3 ( ᵐ5 Μελχολ , Μελχομ ), compare Gie, and Zeph 1:5 ( ᵑ9 ᵑ6 , compare Now), probably 2Sam 12:30 = 1Chr 20:2 (see מֶלֶךְ 5d ), and perhaps Amos 1:15 (whence Jer 49:3 ; compare Dr Now; — not We GASm).

occurrences.englishText: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.

because that they have forsaken me, and have worshiped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, Chemosh the god of Moab, and Milcom the god of the children of Ammon. They have not walked in my ways, to do that which is right in my eyes, and to keep my statutes and my ordinances, as David his father did.

The king defiled the high places that were before Jerusalem, which were on the right hand of the mountain of corruption, which Solomon the king of Israel had built for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Sidonians, and for Chemosh the abomination of Moab, and for Milcom the abomination of the children of Ammon.
By Hodesh his wife, he became the father of Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam,
those who worship the army of the sky on the housetops, those who worship and swear by Yahweh and also swear by Malcam,
